sm_top.sm: Iranian forces targeted oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz with missiles and mines, causing fires and casualties.
A Houthi missile strike damaged Saudi Arabia's tallest skyscraper in Riyadh.
Ukrainian strikes damaged the Crimean road bridge, halting traffic in an attack on the span.
The U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers stationed in the Middle East.
A cruise missile landed in a Polish field near coalition drills, following reports of airspace violations.
Iranian missile/drone attack on Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait killed six US service members and injured eleven.
Houthi forces seized control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait area following the withdrawal of Yemeni government forces.
Israeli ground forces conducted an incursion into central Gaza, crossing the 'Yellow Line' and causing widespread destruction.
Myanmar dismissed the ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide, claiming a lack of consensus among judges.
Russian missile and drone attacks struck Ukraine, killing three water-utility workers and injuring about 15 others in Kyiv.
Explosions were reported in Bahrain amid an Iranian drone attack targeting a US base.
Russian missile strikes hit Kyiv, damaging bridges and killing people.
Houthis advance toward Aden following the withdrawal of government forces from key Red Sea coastal positions.
Poland detained suspects in connection with sabotage and terrorist preparation plots.
Saudi-backed forces launched a major attack on Houthi rebels in Yemen.
Denmark condemned damage to the Austrian and Dutch embassies in Kyiv caused by Russian missile strikes.
Haitian police and security operations in the Martissant district and capital killed 34 suspected gang members, alongside international troop deployments and fighting.
The USS George Washington departed the Middle East after a three-month deployment.
An oil tanker was struck by a projectile or mine near the port of Khasab, Oman, causing a fire.
Israel carried out airstrikes targeting an underground missile site and weapons shipment in eastern Lebanon's Beqaa Valley.
Iranian Army Air Defence claims to have shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across Yemen continue, with reports of at least 11 civilians killed.
Russian strikes and drone attacks on Odesa resulted in casualties and property damage.
The Saudi coalition and Yemen's Houthis exchanged threats of strikes following a Saudi airstrike in Hodeidah.
The Yemeni army reported carrying out over 700 operations against Houthi forces, neutralizing fighters.
Russian forces launched missile and drone attacks striking western Ukraine, including Ivano-Frankivsk and Lviv.
Houthi forces claimed missile and drone strikes on multiple sites in Saudi Arabia, including Jizan and King Khalid Air Base.
Saudi‑led coalition aircraft struck Sana'a, destroying a Houthi missile launcher in Dhamar and hitting a missile and drone depot.
President Zelenskyy announced that Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight, destroying one.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps conducted missile tests and launches from multiple Iranian provinces during military exercises.
Russia deployed ships to the Black Sea and conducted over 20 missile launches against Ukraine.
Russian strikes targeted an energy facility in Odesa Oblast, leaving 41,000 households without power.
Ukrainian long-range drones struck a major petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, Russia.
Russia launched a missile barrage at Ukraine following a meeting between Putin and Trump.
A Houthi attack hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign fund headquarters in Riyadh.
Ukraine endures near-constant air attacks with up to 100 Russian drones during the day and up to 200 at night.
Russian air defenses intercepted 310 Ukrainian drones, with reports of damage to an energy facility in the Smolensk region.
Footage captured a missile strike hitting an Iranian petrochemical plant.
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge using a Ruta Block 1 missile.
A Russian military An-12 transport aircraft crashed in Siberia, resulting in the death of all 19 people on board.
